summary.headline: Venus–Mars Conjunction in Earth Signs
summary.text: Astrological predictions for the conjunction of Venus and Mars in the earthy triplicity, Taurus, Virgo, and Capricorn, including effects on weather, crops, prices, illness, marriage, warfare, rulers, soldiers, and animals. Elevated Mars or Venus brings additional portents for Egypt, Ahvaz, Arab Iraq, the mountains, and Khuzestan.
